definition: Spreading your investments around so you don't lose everything if one crashes.
gaming_analogy: Like not putting all your gaming loot into just one inventory chest. Spread it out!

definition: The total collection of all your investments.
gaming_analogy: Your entire inventory and stash across all your characters.

definition: Betting that a stock's price will go down.
gaming_analogy: Betting against the boss; you win if they lose HP.

definition: When the market is generally going up.
gaming_analogy: Everyone has an XP boost and the server is popping off!

definition: When the market is generally going down.
gaming_analogy: A server-wide debuff where everyone is losing gold.

definition: A portion of a company's profit paid out to shareholders.
gaming_analogy: Passive gold generation just for holding a specific item.

definition: A bundle of many stocks you can buy at once.
gaming_analogy: Buying a starter pack bundle instead of unlocking items one by one.

definition: The first time a company offers its shares to the public.
gaming_analogy: Day 1 launch of a highly anticipated new MMO.

definition: Contracts that give you the right to buy or sell a stock at a set price.
gaming_analogy: Buying a fast-travel pass you can use later, but it expires.

definition: Borrowing money from your broker to buy more stock.
gaming_analogy: Taking out a loan from an NPC to buy endgame gear.

definition: A ratio comparing a company's stock price to its earnings.
gaming_analogy: The cost-to-damage ratio of a weapon; is it worth the gold?

definition: The total dollar value of all a company's shares.
gaming_analogy: The total guild net worth combined.

definition: How easily you can buy or sell an asset without affecting its price.
gaming_analogy: How many players are at the auction house to buy your loot instantly.

definition: How wildly a stock's price swings up and down.
gaming_analogy: A high-risk boss fight where you either get one-shot or get legendary loot.

definition: Shares of large, well-established, and financially sound companies.
gaming_analogy: S-tier meta characters that are always reliable in any patch.
